capture.browser: Installed Google Chrome, headless Chromium driven through Playwright
capture.transport: Every browser request intercepted in-process; application HTML/assets read from sealed build, API responses synthesized in memory. No HTTP server or native app launched.

# Fieldnotes launch brief

A calmer place to collect ideas, shape a plan, and turn the next useful thought into finished work.

## The first release

Keep capture immediate. Make saved notes easy to find. Let the workspace grow with the project.

## What matters

- One clear place to start
- Search that follows your language
- Useful defaults, with room to adjust

## Ready for review

The first-run guide and release notes are prepared for a final editorial pass.
